diff --git a/packaging/bcc-tools.spec b/packaging/bcc-tools.spec
index bf302ad..94365a7 100644
--- a/packaging/bcc-tools.spec
+++ b/packaging/bcc-tools.spec
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+%bcond_with examples
+
+%if %{defined _toolchain}
+%if %{toolchain_is clang}
+%define build_with_libcxx 1
+%endif
+%endif
+
 Name: bcc-tools
 Version: 0.35.0
 Release: 0
@@ -17,6 +25,10 @@ BuildRequires: pkgconfig(zlib)
 BuildRequires: pkgconfig(libbpf)
 BuildRequires: zip
 BuildRequires:  libomp
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+BuildRequires:  libc++-devel
+BuildRequires:  libc++abi-devel
+%endif
 
 %description
 BCC is a toolkit for creating efficient kernel tracing and manipulation
@@ -41,29 +53,47 @@ Requires: %{name}-devel = %{version}-%{release}
 bcc tools - static
 This package provides development libraries.
 
+%if %{with examples}
 %package examples
 Summary: Example codes for BCC
 License: Apache-2.0
 
 %description examples
 This package provides example codes and documents.
+%endif
 
 %prep
 %setup -q -n bcc-tools-%{version}
 
 %build
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++"
+export LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++ -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed"
+%endif
+
 #DREVISION - number which will be put at back of the package name if repo isn't available
 LLVM_VERSION_MAJOR=$(llvm-config --version | cut -d. -f1)
 LLVM_SHARED_FLAG=
 if [ "${LLVM_VERSION_MAJOR}" -ge 22 ]; then
     LLVM_SHARED_FLAG="-DENABLE_LLVM_SHARED=ON"
 fi
-cmake -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr -DINSTALL_CPP_EXAMPLES=ON ${LLVM_SHARED_FLAG} -DREVISION="%{version}" -DCMAKE_USE_LIBBPF_PACKAGE:BOOL=TRUE .
+
+%if %{with examples}
+%global install_cpp_examples ON
+%else
+%global install_cpp_examples OFF
+%endif
+
+cmake -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr -DINSTALL_CPP_EXAMPLES=%{install_cpp_examples} ${LLVM_SHARED_FLAG} -DREVISION="%{version}" -DCMAKE_USE_LIBBPF_PACKAGE:BOOL=TRUE .
 make %{?jobs:-j%jobs}
 
 %install
 make install DESTDIR=%{buildroot}
 
+%if %{without examples}
+rm -rf %{buildroot}%{_datadir}/bcc
+%endif
+
 %clean
 rm -rf %{buildroot}
 
@@ -86,5 +116,7 @@ rm -rf %{buildroot}
 %{_libdir}/libbcc-loader-static.a
 %{_libdir}/libbcc_bpf.a
 
+%if %{with examples}
 %files examples
 %{_datadir}/bcc/*
+%endif

    packaging: use libc++ with the platform Clang toolchain
    
    Add the libc++ development dependencies and C++ compile/link flags only
    when _toolchain is defined and toolchain_is clang is true. Preserve the
    GCC path and configurations without the platform toolchain selection.
    
    仅在平台 Clang 工具链路径启用 libc++，保持 GCC 路径及未启用该工具链
    配置的现有行为。改动仅涉及打包参数，不修改上游 C++ 源码。

 1 file changed, 15 insertions(+)
